creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Everything in architecture.md rests on facts read from herdr's source, not observed running. Verify the four load-bearing ones against a live daemon with a throwaway script - no build system, no surface:

1. session.snapshot returns live structure (panes, tabs, agent states), not a restore tree.
2. 'terminal session control' emits server-rendered frame diffs, and mode-setting sequences (DECSET 2004/1049, CSI > u, mouse 1000/1006) are consumed rather than forwarded - the fact that moves input encoding out of the surface.
3. Five agent states including unknown, and idle-vs-done actually flips on backend-recognized focus.
4. direct_attach_resize_locks: a controlling client holds pane geometry against the TUI.

Cheaper to be wrong here than in Swift with a GPU surface attached. The recordings are also the first corpus for the grid-snapshot harness and the fake daemon (testing.md: record reality, replay it as data) - they cannot be captured more cheaply than now. Save raw transcripts, not summaries.
title: Observe real herdr 0.8.0 on the wire, before any Swift
